vue-components.name: AppSortable
vue-components.description: Minimal, Vue 3 sortable list component, with no dependencies.

attributes.name: model-value
attributes.description: The list of items that need to be sorted. Use with v-model.

attributes.name: item-key

value.type: string | ((item: any, index: number) => string | number)

attributes.description: The unique key used to identify each element from the list. It can be a function which receives the `item` and `index` as parameters or a string representing a key on the item object.

attributes.name: handle
attributes.description: CSS class selector used as a drag handle. If the handle is not provided, the item can be moved from anywhere.

attributes.name: item-class
attributes.description: CSS class applied to the items.

attributes.name: transition-group-name
attributes.description: The name of the transition used for the `TransitionGroup` that is wrapping the list.

attributes.name: drag-threshold
attributes.description: The minimum number of pixels after it's considered a drag event.

attributes.name: drag-delay
attributes.description: The time in milliseconds after the event is registered as a drag.

attributes.name: drag-delay-on-touch-only
attributes.description: Whether the `dragDelay` prop should apply only on mobile devices.

attributes.name: auto-scroll
attributes.description: Whether to auto-scroll when dragging an item near the edges.

attributes.name: auto-scroll-margin
attributes.description: The distance from the container edge that triggers auto-scrolling (in pixels).

attributes.name: auto-scroll-speed
attributes.description: The speed at which auto-scrolling occurs.

events.name: update:model-value
events.description: Emitted with the reordered list, use for v-model.

arguments.name: index
arguments.description: The initial index of the dragged element.

events.name: change
events.description: Emitted when the dragged item's index changes during a drag.

arguments.name: oldIndex
arguments.description: The initial index of the dragged element.

arguments.name: newIndex
arguments.description: The current index of the dragged element.

arguments.name: oldIndex
arguments.description: The initial index of the dragged element.

arguments.name: newIndex
arguments.description: The final index of the dragged element.

slots.name: item
slots.description: The content of each sortable item.

vue-properties.name: item
vue-properties.description: The current item from the list.

vue-properties.name: index
vue-properties.description: The index of the current item.
